description: For five offers ("upgrade" for room upgrades, "earlyLate" check-in/check-out, "spa", "dining" and experiences, airport "transfer"), sales = arrivals × take-up %, revenue = sales × average price, contribution = revenue less direct cost %. Revenue is split pre-arrival vs front desk; platform commission applies to pre-arrival revenue, a staff incentive to front-desk revenue, and a fixed monthly platform fee (×12 for a year). Returns revenue, profit, revenue and profit per arrival, and, with room nights available, RevPAR uplift (upgrades and early/late only, a modelling choice) and TRevPAR uplift (all offers). Default take-up rates are illustrative examples, not benchmarks: pass your own. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/hotel-upsell-revenue-calculator
